editorial:
Imagine meeting a guy who claims he is from the future, but he's actually cute and sweet. That is exactly what happens to Maggie, a regular girl living in the West Country. When Craig shows up with a wild story about wormholes and saving the world, you really feel Maggie's struggle. You will wonder if she is actually falling for a time traveler or if she is just so lonely that she wants to believe him. The vibe is a cozy mix of a small-town romance and a high-stakes sci-fi thriller that keeps you guessing about what is real.

The acting is great, and the chemistry between the two leads makes the crazy plot feel grounded. While some of the science parts get a bit confusing, the emotional twists make up for it. If you love stories that pull at your heartstrings while keeping you on the edge of your seat, you need to see this.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out that Craig really is from the future, but his mission was a lie to get close to Maggie. He actually came back to stop her from making a choice that destroys the world. In the final scene, they decide to stay together and risk everything. They close the wormhole forever, meaning Craig can never go home, but they get to live a normal life together in the present.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves a good love story with a crazy twist.
